response = await callApi('POST', '/gambit/sessions/active/resolve-effect', { Positions: candidates.slice(0, required).map((card) => card.Position) }, token);

const event = current.Grid.PendingEvent; const goodIndex = Array.isArray(event.GoodOptions) ? event.GoodOptions.findIndex((option) => typeof option === 'string' && option.length > 0) : -1; const badIndex = Array.isArray(event.BadOptions) ? event.BadOptions.findIndex((option) => typeof option === 'string' && option.length > 0) : -1;
if (goodIndex < 0 || goodIndex > 2 || badIndex < 0 || badIndex > 2) throw new Error(label + ': pending event lacks valid choices.');
response = await callApi('POST', '/gambit/sessions/active/resolve-event', { GoodIndex: goodIndex, BadIndex: badIndex }, token);

if (recordAssertions) check(label + ' resolves its own pending state #' + steps, () => pm.expect(response.code).to.eql(201)); else if (response.code !== 201) throw new Error(label + ': resolution returned ' + response.code + '.');
if (session.Status !== 'InProgress' || session.Grid.PendingEvent || session.Grid.PendingInteraction) throw new Error(label + ' requires an unblocked InProgress session.');
const target = session.Grid.Unrevealed.find((card) => card.Locked === false); check(label + ' has a valid card available to burn', () => pm.expect(target).to.exist);

const response = await callApi('POST', '/gambit/sessions/active/burn/' + target.Position, undefined, token); check(label + ' burn succeeds through the real API', () => pm.expect(response.code).to.eql(201));
const burned = sessionView(response.json()); assertSessionShape(burned, label + ' result');

check(label + ' changes deterministic invariants only in its owner session', () => { pm.expect(burned.GambitSessionId).to.eql(session.GambitSessionId); pm.expect(burned.UserId).to.eql(session.UserId); pm.expect(burned.ManualFlipsCount).to.eql(session.ManualFlipsCount + 1); pm.expect(burned.Grid.Revealed.length).to.eql(session.Grid.Revealed.length + 1); pm.expect(burned.Grid.Unrevealed.length).to.eql(session.Grid.Unrevealed.length - 1); });
let response = await callApi('GET', '/gambit/sessions/active', undefined, token); if (response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Active lookup returned ' + response.code + '.');

if (current.Status === 'Finished') { const cashOut = await callApi('POST', '/gambit/sessions/active/cash-out', undefined, token); if (cashOut.code !== 201) throw new Error('Cash-out returned ' + cashOut.code + '.'); return { finished: current, cashOut }; }
if (current.Status !== 'InProgress') return { finished: current, cashOut: null };
if (current.Grid.PendingInteraction || current.Grid.PendingEvent) { current = await resolveBlockingState(current, token, 'cleanup', false); continue; }
const target = current.Grid.Unrevealed.find((card) => card.Locked === false); if (!target) throw new Error('No burnable cleanup card.');

response = await callApi('POST', '/gambit/sessions/active/burn/' + target.Position, undefined, token); if (response.code !== 201) throw new Error('Cleanup burn returned ' + response.code + '.'); current = sessionView(response.json());
} if (current) throw new Error('Cleanup exceeded 100 actions.'); return { finished: null, cashOut: null };

async function cleanupUser(token, label) { await finishAndCashOut(token); const response = await callApi('DELETE', '/user', undefined, token); if (response.code !== 200) throw new Error(label + ' deactivation returned ' + response.code + '.'); return response; }
const tokenA = pm.variables.get('tc019TokenA'); const tokenB = pm.variables.get('tc019TokenB');

check('user B session lookup after user A action returns 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const bAfterA = pm.response.json(); assertSessionShape(bAfterA, 'user B session after user A action');
check('user A action leaves the complete user B Gambit state unchanged', () => pm.expect(bAfterA).to.deep.equal(snapshotB));

const balanceAAfterB = await read('/user/chips', tokenA, 'user A balance after user B action'); check('user B action leaves user A balance unchanged', () => pm.expect(balanceAAfterB).to.deep.equal(balanceABeforeB));
